study: E4a: RoBERTa-base second-backbone replication of E1b/E1c (LoRA merge-overlap paper)
written_kst: 2026-09-26, before any E4a training (pilot included); see prereg_e4a.sha256 file time

written_after_results_known.E1b: BERT-base, seed 0 shared: H1 FAIL rho=-0.194 CI[-0.521,0.203]; H2 INCONCLUSIVE rho=-0.044 CI[-0.425,0.316]; min theta_min 45.1 deg; gate 0/91
written_after_results_known.E1c: BERT-base, mixed seed P: H1c INCONCLUSIVE rho=-0.025 CI[-0.51,0.43]; H2c INCONCLUSIVE rho=0.127 CI[-0.35,0.49]; S1 both INCONCLUSIVE; S2 min theta 39.8 deg; gate 0/196; D reliability R0~P 0.67
written_after_results_known.E3: no method beat TA by >=0.5pp; PICO_TA +0.22pp; FORCEGATE -0.03pp; GATE == TA

recipe.target_modules_note: PEFT suffix match: 'output.dense' matches attention.output.dense and layer.N.output.dense; 12 x 6 = 72 LoRA layers. RobertaForSequenceClassification has no pooler; its classification head (classifier.dense 768x768 + tanh + classifier.out_proj) is fully trained (modules_to_save) and is NOT LoRA-adapted.
recipe.lr_note: E1b value; replaced only by the pre-registered pilot rule (pilot.lr_ladder); main training reads pilot/pilot_decision.json
recipe.scheduler: linear with warmup; warmup_steps = min(500, round(0.1*max_steps)) (E1b budgets)
recipe.segment_ids: none: RoBERTa type_vocab_size=1; tokenizer returns no token_type_ids; token_type_ids are never passed to the model in training, integrity (c), or evaluation (equivalent to all zeros)
recipe.pair_encoding: RoBERTa tokenizer default <s> A </s></s> B </s>, truncation longest_first at 128
seed_applies_to: transformers.set_seed before model construction (LoRA-A init, head init)

budgets.source: E1b prereg.json budgets (identical per task); mnli = E1b deviation D1 (full pool 391,702, 3 epochs, 36,723 steps, warmup 500)
budgets.splits: E1b tasks.split_indices unmodified (held-out 1,000 TRAIN examples seed 0; 60k seeded cap; eval <=10k seeded subset); train/held-out index sha256 must equal the E1b adapter train_meta.json (asserted)

pilot.budget: E1b budgets for the task (sst2 5,625 steps; rte 470 steps), recipe identical to main
pilot.evaluation: held-out 1,000 TRAIN examples only (manual merge, fp32); NO eval-set scoring
pilot.divergence_rule: a pilot task diverged if ANY: (i) a logged training loss is NaN/inf; (ii) mean logged training loss over the last 20% of logged steps >= 0.9 x entropy (nats) of the training-label prior; (iii) held-out accuracy < held-out majority-class baseline (majority label from training labels) + 10pp
pilot.decision: lr_main = first ladder lr (in order 1e-3, 5e-4, 2e-4) at which neither pilot task diverged; the next ladder lr is piloted only if the previous one diverged
pilot.rule_if_all_diverge: use the ladder lr with the highest mean held-out accuracy over the two pilot tasks, document, and proceed (integrity rule then applies)

integrity.a: metric >= majority-class baseline + 0.10 (E1b definition); stsb Spearman >= 0.70

b_reference.source: fairseq examples/roberta/README.md @ commit 3d262bb25690e4eb2e7d3c1309b1e9c406ca4b99, table 'GLUE (dev set, single model, single-task finetuning)', row roberta.base
b_reference.rule: ours >= reference - 0.05 on the listed metric (7 GLUE tasks; qqp not trained)
b_reference.caveats: full fine-tuning, full training data, fairseq best-checkpoint-on-dev over a hyperparameter search; README does not name the STS-B metric (compared with our Spearman) or CoLA metric (63.6 is MCC by GLUE convention); our adapters use LoRA r=8 with held-out-reduced and 60k-capped pools

integrity.c: max |logit(manual merge W0+dW + own head) - logit(PeftModel)| <= 1e-4 on the first 64 eval examples, fp32, TF32 disabled, no token_type_ids
integrity.structural: 72 LoRA layers; head dense (768,768)+bias, out_proj (n_labels,768)+bias; r/alpha; train/held-out index sha256 = train_meta; main-run adapter of the right seed
integrity.exclusion: a task failing any criterion in EITHER seed is removed with all its pairs from EVERY population (complete K-task design)

predictors.O_A: mean over the 72 LoRA layers of mean_k cos^2 theta_k, principal angles between orth(B1) and orth(B2), float64
predictors.tv_cosine: cosine of flattened concatenated dW = 2 B A
predictors.null: 1000 random rank-8 subspace pairs per layer (seed 0)

merge.method: task arithmetic W0 + lam*(dW1+dW2) on all 72 LoRA layers; each task with its own classifier head
merge.lambda_selection: per pair, maximize mean normalized score on the two 1,000-example held-out TRAIN sets; ties -> smaller lam
merge.normalized_score: merged / single on the same set (accuracy; stsb Spearman); single of each side = its own adapter
merge.D: 1 - mean of the two normalized eval-set scores at the selected lam
merge.exploratory: TIES-lite and theta*=30 deg hard gate exactly as E1b

populations.P_primary: mixed-seed cross-task pairs: alphabetically-first task (python sorted) seed 0 = t1, other task seed 1 = t2 (E1c rule)
populations.R0_secondary: seed-0 cross-task pairs, E1b task-list order (E1b confirmatory design)
populations.S1_secondary: seed-1 cross-task pairs, E1b task-list order
populations.S2_secondary: same-task seed pairs t@s0 (t1) x t@s1 (t2)

analysis.multiplicity: Holm over {H1, H2} on one-sided permutation p (primary population P only)
analysis.permutation: 10,000 task relabelings of the D matrix, predictor fixed, default_rng(0); p = (1 + #{rho_perm >= rho_obs}) / 10001
analysis.bootstrap: task-block, 2,000 reps, default_rng(0), skip resamples with < 4 distinct pairs, percentile 95% CI
analysis.loto: rho with each valid task removed
analysis.rule: PASS iff rho >= 0.4 AND Holm p < 0.05 AND >= 75% LOTO rho > 0.2; FAIL iff not PASS and bootstrap upper < 0.3; else INCONCLUSIVE; per hypothesis
analysis.code: statistics copied verbatim from E1c e1c_analysis.pop_stats (= e1b.stage3)
analysis.secondary_populations: R0 and S1: identical statistics, Holm within population, rule applied descriptively ('rule outcome')
analysis.pooled_exploratory: for each unordered task pair: mean of D and of each predictor over R0, S1, P; same statistics (descriptive)
secondary: O_A vs random-subspace null (z, fraction above null p95)
D / O_A / tv_cosine / lam* reliability across seed configurations (Spearman R0~S1, R0~P, S1~P)

S2 same-task pairs: theta_min, gate firing, D, E1b-stage2 gate vs TA; E3 run() subset TA / PICO_TA / GATE / FORCEGATE with amendment-A2 grids (contrasts: mean, bootstrap CI over tasks 2,000, sign-flip p 10,000, W/T/L)
fixed-lambda rho curves, secondary predictors, TIES-lite/gate comparison for P, R0, S1
cross-backbone: Spearman of per-task-pair D and O_A between RoBERTa and BERT (E1b R0 vs E4a R0; E1c P vs E4a P) on common valid tasks

compute_budget.definition: wall-clock from the first E4a GPU job (pilot) to the end of the last E4a GPU job; summed process-hours are also reported
compute_budget.unfinished_work: reported as not run; never used as partial evidence for a verdict
